notes: Local macOS diagnostics only; exact independently built baseline and source-snapshot candidate.

The width-8 dataset has 800 distinct (g1,g3) pairs and 800 g1 levels; g3 is exactly a function of g1. Thus its weighted nuisance Schur complement is identically zero for every positive Hessian weight.
PPML alone removes this redundant projection recipe, using original full-model admission and certification. Canonical rank, DoF, checkpoints, saved effects, OLS, and upstream CMG are unchanged.
Combined matched route receipts remain red wherever the old baseline falls back. The new candidate result is reported separately; no failed receipt is relabelled green.
Iteration units sum per-frame maximum RHS recurrence counts, not all graph operator applications. Failed baseline frames have public total iterations but no certified-frame split trace.
No publication tolerance, independent certificate, numerical factor policy, or public solver/auto policy changes.
